applies_why: The judge text records that the challenger and defender answered the Isaiah 7:14 wording and application, which is the answered-verse treatment K-G4 governs.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it — one reading forbids treating an answered verse as an unanswered or broken-link witness; the other permits only recording that an answer was given.
why: The judge expressly treats the virgin/young-woman and prophetic-application points as answered and does not count any verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link, so it obeys K-G4.
